narratives.Overview: A small web app that exposes a health endpoint and serves a minimal HTML status page. The page calls the endpoint once on load and shows the service state and timestamp.
narratives.Architecture: A single Node.js process using plain JavaScript and Node's built-in HTTP server serves both the HTML page and GET /health on port 3000.
narratives.TechStack: Web App using Node.js and plain JavaScript — Node's built-in HTTP server with no web framework.
narratives.Quality: Run task check before every commit. Achieve >= 85% coverage overall + per-module. Store secrets in secrets/ dir.
